summary: Deleting a dataset or method from the Project Instance table responds much faster over a network drive.
details: Finding which cached files a dataset owns now reads the folder listing instead of opening every sidecar, and only method files still need their payload.
The table redraws from the index the delete already returned instead of re-reading it from the share.
Index scans use a wider worker pool, so the remaining rebuild spends less time waiting on network round trips.
